name: scene_vm_wait
comment: frames before the VM runs again

name: scene_vm_result
comment: result register: actor_get, flag_test, ...; store_result writes it out

name: map_change_map
comment: op 24 target map; $045A kind, $0463 x, $0465 y, $0467 facing

name: scene_events
comment: unpacked scene event data (header, then VM code)

name: char_records
comment: 8 x 0x100: +1 id, +0x22 status, +0x50/52 HP, +0x56/58 MP, +0xD8 SP; slots 0-3 at $73E1 = battle party

name: text_framebuffer
comment: WRAM 2bpp text window bitmap, tile 0x328.. (4 lines x 26 cols x 16px), mirrors VRAM $5940

name: script_buffer
comment: WRAM unpacked scene script (many strings, FFFF-terminated), filled at scene load

name: scene_zones
comment: zone table, 5-byte entries, scanned by C6:54BB

name: unpack
comment: LZ: dest = DB:X; DB=$7E path uses its own copy, any other bank: literals sta.w 0,x but back-refs mvn $7F,$7F (hardcoded)

name: sched_main
comment: cooperative task scheduler root; all task chains start here (shadow-stack switches)

name: wait_vblank
comment: wait for the start of vblank

name: nmi_dma_jobs
comment: NMI VRAM/CGRAM/OAM job runner; flag bytes $F3/$F4 select jobs; S-DD1 jobs arm $4800 + DMAP=$09

name: nmi_text_upload
comment: per-glyph DMA of text framebuffer $7E:A353.. -> VRAM $5940..

name: scene_vm_frame
comment: scene event VM, per frame: runs from $0238 until a yielding op ($0231<0 skips, $0234 countdown)

name: scene_vm_frame_loop
comment: per-op loop: stz $023A, X=(op+1)*2 into C2:3769

name: scene_vm_run
comment: scene event VM, runs until FF (trigger scripts that must finish at once)

name: scene_op_set
comment: op 01: dest value, RPN expression to FF, store by dest type bits 3-5 (C2:16DD)

name: scene_op_if
comment: op 07: then word, else word, condition list

name: scene_vm_join
comment: condition joiner: 00 or, 01 and, else end

name: text_message_select_event
comment: event op path: same `lda $B873,x / adc #$B873 / sta $03D5` as text_message_select (patched: sram_text)

name: scene_vm_say_mode
comment: say ops: window mode in A then the message (0D/0E/25/39/3C)

name: text_message_select
comment: X=msg*2: $03D5 = $B873 + [$B873+X]; hook point to stream one message into the buffer

name: scene_op_syscall
comment: op 0F N: jsl C2:8B46 with X = N*2, A = var.w[0]; services take var.w[2..], answer in $0278

name: scene_op_map_change
comment: op 24 map,kind,x,y,facing -> $0461/$045A/$0463 x*8/$0465 y*8-16/$0467; fade request, VM stopped (C2:21F7)

name: scene_vm_value
comment: operand value: F0-FF run, bit7 var ($7E:FEC3+i) / bit6 sys (C2:383F), else imm (t&3)+1 bytes

name: scene_events_init
comment: scene load: entries -> $7E:E613+kind*0x100+(id*2&FF), pc = header end + [$3102], stack $FFF2, one VM pass

name: scene_vm_opcodes
comment: opcode handlers, word per op, indexed (op+1)*2: 00-69, FF at index 0

name: text_task
comment: dialog task body (yields per glyph = typewriter)

name: text_fetch
comment: read stream code at $03D5: varint, FFFF end, FFFE rewind

name: text_dispatch
comment: 5..4000 glyph=code-5 -> C2:63A0; else control via C2:3B2F

name: text_control_table
comment: 16 handlers indexed (code+1)&FF: 4001 var,0 nl,1 page,2 str,3 speed,4 color,4006 item,4007/8 mode,4009 pos,400A spacing,400B narration,400C leader,400D/E member

name: names8_lookup
comment: id scan D7:06FA, offset D7:0000 + D7:0DF6

name: text_peek
comment: look-ahead fetch inside the message; FFFE rewinds to $03D7

name: text_blit_glyph
comment: A=glyph: FF:(A*32) 16x16 1bpp (L col 16B, R col 16B) -> shift by $D9&7 into $0331.. -> 2bpp compose (mode $03DE) -> framebuffer

name: narration_line_load
comment: text-VM op: S-DD1 line image for screen $03E6, line $0490 -> VRAM 5940/5AE0/5C80/5E20 + palette -> $03E0

name: narration_table
comment: 13 x 16B: four 3B S-DD1 line ptrs (E3FFF7=blank), 3B palette ptr (colours 1-3 at +2), pad. 0x340 B/line = 208x16 2bpp cells

name: display_reinit
comment: force blank, clear OAM/CGRAM, base palettes

name: palette_blend
comment: precompute blend steps of 0x70 colours into a $7F buffer

name: obj_frame_load
comment: sheet $00, anim $02, frame $04, slot $06 (bit 15 wide) via S-DD1 DMA C2:A2A4

name: actor_mode_run
comment: actor +0x07 scripted mode through C2:A8E9, counter +0x22

name: obj_anim_stream
comment: per-frame S-DD1 sprite frame streams -> $7F:E000.. (OBJ staging)

name: scene_load
comment: scene/map loader; unpacks map/gfx/script blobs via unpack

name: scene_load_tables
comment: index scene_table, unpack event + text blocks

name: scene_zone_test
comment: hero tile vs zone table $EB8E+5n (x1,y1,x2,y2,..), $0241 end; while walking

name: inventory_add
comment: $00 item, $02 count, $03 clamp-to-20: carry set = failed

name: actor_popup
comment: popup object over actor Y (template 0x2F, sound 0x12)

name: menu_draw_string16_id
comment: id lookup in $7F:2000/2800/3000, u16 glyph+0x10 via copy_char

name: scene_a_button
comment: A in the field: if op at pc != FF and entry 2/0x7F ($E911) set, push pc and call it

name: actor_alloc
comment: free actor slot ($2F80 down to $2040), carry set = none

name: copy_char16
comment: blit 16x16 glyph X=glyph*0x20 as 2bpp into $7F:E000 buffer

name: menu_draw_string8
comment: 8x8 string -> tilemap shadow at X, attr $26; C0-F2 voiced w/ dakuten row above, FC nl, FF end

name: char_find
comment: A = id from 1: carry clear, X = record ($7E:6FE1 + k*0x100); else carry set

name: sfx_panned
comment: sound effect panned by the leader's screen x

name: battle16_strings
comment: u16 codes glyph+0x10, 000D nl, FFFF end

name: font_menu_8x8
comment: S-DD1 0xC00: 192 2bpp 8x8 tiles -> VRAM $2000; ASCII 0x20-0x5F then katakana, hiragana

name: scene_table
comment: 94 x 6B: event LZ ptr (-> $7E:3100), text LZ ptr (-> $7E:B873); scene id-1

name: script_scene_first_room
comment: 0x83 container: first playable room script (unpacked to $7E:B873)

name: menu_element_sprites
comment: S-DD1 0x800 4bpp OBJ (resist elements with baked kanji) -> VRAM $7400

name: font_dialog_16x16
comment: dialog/menu font: uncompressed 16x16 1bpp, 32B/glyph (left 8px col 16B, right col 16B), <=0x640 glyphs (FF:C800 is a compressed blob). glyph=code-5; 0=space 1..10 digits, kana, A-Z ~0xE4, kanji after
